## Description
Briefly describe the change and its rationale.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue)
- [ ] New statutory record or dataset enhancement
- [ ] Typo / statutory amendment correction
- [ ] UI / UX refinement or accessibility improvement
- [ ] Security / rate limiting hardening
- [ ] Documentation update

## Source Verification (For Legal Data Changes)
- [ ] Primary source verified on `bdlaws.minlaw.gov.bd` or `bdcode.gov.bd`
- [ ] Gazette citation included
- [ ] No copyrighted headnotes or commentaries copied from commercial publishers
- [ ] `integrityStatus` set honestly (`source-linked`, `reviewed`, or `unverified`)

## Pre-flight Checklist
- [ ] `bun test` passes (0 failed)
- [ ] `npm run lint` passes (0 errors, 0 warnings)
- [ ] `npm run typecheck` passes
- [ ] `npm run build` succeeds
- [ ] No secrets or API keys committed
- [ ] Tested on mobile and desktop viewports
